title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: custom engine agents for DoD users
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented limits, licensing and control references are supported. It distinguishes the launched DoD capability from unconfirmed admin-UI availability and the block API's documented DoD exclusion.
